subject: Flexible rebate authorization request — IDEXA pilot (VP/CFO signoff requested)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@idexahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ian Thompson <ian.thompson@idexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot rebate ask — Redwood + IDEXA

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. IDEXA is interested in a 6-month pilot for our intake automation workflow. We like Redwood's latency and the model routing notes you shared. To make the commercials work for our board we need a one-time rebate applied to the pilot package. Specifically: 

- Requested structure: up to $80,000 rebate, to be applied as a mix of onboarding credit and usage rebate tied to a 6-month minimum.
- Primary ask: rebate available if usage >= 60% of projected tokens in months 2–6.
- Secondary: provide a 30-day cleanup window for data retention terms in the SOW.

I've attached the SOW (Idexa_SOW_v1.pdf) with the usage guidance. Can you route to pricing/finance and let me know what you can approve? We prefer a single credit on the invoice rather than multi-line billing adjustments.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — board meets 3/12 and we'd like terms by next week.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Idexa Health

Attachments: Idexa_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@idexahealth.com>, Ian Thompson <ian.thompson@idexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot rebate ask — Redwood + IDEXA 

Marissa / Grace —

Forwarding Alicia's ask. Summary: IDEXA wants a capped pilot rebate (requested up to $80k) tied to a 6-month minimum and a simple single-credit invoicing approach. They need terms before 3/12 for an upcoming board review.

Proposal (sales recommended; attached model): 
- Option A (faster close): $60,000 capped rebate composed of $20k onboarding credit + up to $40k retroactive usage rebate (paid as a credit on the invoice after month 6 if usage thresholds met).
- Option B (higher incentive): $80,000 capped rebate composed of $30k onboarding + up to $50k usage rebate; requires 9-month commitment or an explicit performance SLA.

Risks/controls I propose if we approve Option B: 
- Rebate paid only if cumulative usage >= 60% of projected tokens across months 2–6.
- Rebate clawback clause if customer terminates early within 6 months (pro-rata).
- Add explicit spend floor or minimum monthly commitment to avoid trivial usage triggering rebate.

Files attached for finance review: rebate_model.xlsx (breakout by month, token bands, pro-forma P&L).

Ask: Marissa — can you sign off on Option A today, or Option B with your edits? If you prefer, I can route a short memo to VP/CFO for formal signoff and stamp to the Deal Desk. 

If you want me to propose a redline to the SOW with the rebate language I can send that to Alicia by EOD.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: rebate_model.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@idexahealth.com>, Ian Thompson <ian.thompson@idexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rebate ask — Redwood + IDEXA (internal clearance)

Marcus / Grace —

Thanks for the summary and the model. I reviewed the numbers and the proposed controls. I will approve a modified Option B under the following conditions: 

- Final approved cap: $45,000 usage-related rebate (not $50k). Combined with a $25,000 onboarding credit this yields a $70,000 effective cap.
- Customer must sign a 9-month commitment OR agree to a 12-month clawback schedule if they terminate early.
- Rebate payout triggers: cumulative usage >= 60% of the forecast over months 2–9 (adjust months to match 9-month commitment).
- Add a one-time Compliance attestation clause in the SOW about data retention (30 days cleanup window accepted).
- Finance to record as a contra-revenue credit item and route through Deal Desk code DEAL-1457 for audit.

I've attached a redline with the rebate language and a short memo for the ledger entry (rebate_terms_redline.docx). Marcus — please share this redlined SOW with IDEXA and confirm acceptance. Once they countersign, I'll route for a final billing note and record the deal in the ledger.

Marissa Cole
CFO (interim) — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: rebate_terms_redline.docx

Subject: Re: Pilot rebate ask — Redwood + IDEXA — revised approval and next steps

Alicia / Ian —

Thanks — good news. Finance has approved a revised commercial that we can put in the SOW: 

- Commercial summary (approved): $25,000 onboarding credit + up to $45,000 usage rebate (effective cap $70k).
- Commitment terms: 9-month minimum commitment OR 12-month clawback schedule if customer terminates early.
- Payout triggers: cumulative usage >= 60% of forecast across months 2–9 (we'll use the usage bands in the attached rebate_model.xlsx).
- Compliance: 30-day data cleanup window included in SOW per your request.

Marissa has attached a redline for the SOW language. Please confirm you accept these terms and I'll circulate a countersigned SOW and issue the single credit on the invoice per your preference.

Next steps: 
1) Alicia — confirm acceptance of the revised cap and commitment language by EOD 3/7 so we can meet your board timeline.
2) If accepted, I'll issue a countersigned SOW and route for the billing credit.
3) Grace will scope onboarding tasks and estimate the delivery window; she'll follow up separately.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the payout mechanics.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
